data.description: 【令 · 江上画舫夜航】月夜下的江面浮光跃金，一艘描金画舫缓缓行于水上。令倚在舫头凭栏，素白羽衣的衣摆浸着水光，提着一只酒盏遥遥对月。江风送来她低低的吟诵——「醉后不知天在水，满船清梦压星河。」
data.lighting: moonlit river reflections, golden lantern bokeh from the cabin, silver water ripples
data.promptProse: Ling leans on the gilt pleasure boat's bow railing, raising a wine cup toward the moon in her white feathered robe. The wide medium view includes the cabin behind her and a river stretching along the boat's direction of travel. Golden cabin lanterns warm the carved rail and sleeve folds; broken silver moonlight ripples below and touches the robe hem as she quietly recites verse.
data.title: 令 · 江上画舫夜航
